summary: Guidance triage UI shipped in public/graph.html (renderGuidance rework). Review chip is now an actionable list: dup-cluster rows get [Consolidate]/[Distinct] + expandable member list (lazy /task/detail fetch, per-note label+summary, radio keeper pick sent as `keep`); non-cluster rows get inline input + [Answer] posting {id,answer}; blocking banner rows get the same answer affordance. "Consolidate all (N)" bulk (review dup-clusters only, confirm() gated, sequential, per-row ✓/✗). Failures surface inline (red row + error text, kept in guidErr across renders). Re-render is signature-gated against the 2s tick so typing/expansion/drafts survive; force-render after resolves. Merged cleanly with the concurrently-shipped Copy-for-Claude button (guidanceItems map reused). Verified: node --check OK, daemon serves new code, throwaway review item posted+resolved via {id,answer} round-trip, 2 real cluster items left untouched (both now carry full dup-cluster action payloads → fully triageable in UI). Gap noted: POST /guidance halts ALL loops (L.active=false) even for severity:'review' — review posts shouldn't pause; harmless here (all loops already inactive).
